question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Twilio RCS as a bundled official channel despite the existing external channel-plugin surface?
rationale: The code can live outside core today, while bundling adds a large commercial-service configuration, credential, delivery, and maintenance surface; automation cannot choose that ownership commitment.

options.title: External plugin plus narrow core seam
options.body: Publish the RCS channel externally and submit only any generally useful route-registration or SMS hardening as a separate focused core PR.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept RCS as an official bundled channel and require live approved-sender proof, dependency authorization, compatibility evidence, and the remaining patch repair before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the feature discussion open but defer this implementation until demand and an ongoing owner justify the bundled maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus narrow core seam
recommendation.body: Publish the RCS channel externally and submit only any generally useful route-registration or SMS hardening as a separate focused core PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the bundled Twilio channel family this person introduced and requires repository-level product ownership.
